'''Ossorus''' was a beautiful [[Water/Legends|underwater]] [[City/Legends|city]] in the [[Gungan religion|religion]] of the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It was believed to be the home of the Gungan [[God/Legends|deities]] known as [[Gud/Legends|guds]], including the chief deity [[Oma-Oma]].<ref name="GB" /> The god of destruction, [[Mekamok]], also lived in Ossorus even though he was considered the only gud outside of Oma-Oma's authority. As such, the other guds avoided him.<ref name="French" />

According to legend, Ossorus was protected by [[Balam]], the first Gungan [[Militiagung/Legends|warrior]]. Upon Balam's [[Death/Legends|death]], Oma-Oma took him to Ossorus and granted him [[Immortality/Legends|immortality]] in exchange for teaching the other guds the art of warfare. Balam also created the city [[Otoh-D'in]], where the bravest Gungan warriors arrived after their deaths. The legions there were pledged to defend Ossorus if it ever came under attack from Mekamok and his acolytes.<ref name="French">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', French edition</ref> The Gungans also believed that Ossorus was protected by enchanted [[Sando aqua monster/Legends|sando aqua monsters]] and giant Gungan warriors atop loyal [[Kaadu/Legends|kaadu]] mounts.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ossorus was first mentioned in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''.<ref name="GB" />
